snippet.title: I'm a wakesurfer, not a coder, so I built my own wakesurf game | Episode 1: The Lake
snippet.description:
Play free at https://mitchell-gaming.com on your phone or computer. No download, no sign-up.

I couldn't find a real wakesurfing game anywhere, so I built one. This first episode opens with a glimpse of Level 14, the Mega Yacht. Then I ride the first three levels at the lake: getting up and tossing the rope, a night session under the boat lights, and a storm with lightning. After that: the controls, the trick demo and the leaderboards.

Code YTWAKE = 500 coins (in the game: Settings → HAVE A CODE?)
